title: Deploying a Control-Logic LLM Assistant in Air-Gapped Power Plants: Lessons in Source Authority and Bounded Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2611.20398v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Deploying Large Language Model (LLM) assistants in industrial operational technology environments poses constraints largely absent from cloud applications: site policies restrict engineering and operational data from leaving the plant, on-premises compute is limited, and incorrect causal attribution can mislead incident response. We report lessons from deploying a control-logic evidence layer that underpins a broader on-premises operator assistance system at two gas power plants. Two prototypes revealed where generative models added avoidable uncertainty and cost. The first used a Vision Language Model (VLM) to reconstruct control topology from PDF printouts routinely exchanged by engineers. translated_title: 在物理隔离（气隙）电厂中部署控制逻辑LLM助手：关于信息源权威性与受限检索的经验教训
translated_abstract: 在工业运营技术（OT）环境中部署大语言模型（LLM）助手面临诸多云应用中基本不存在的约束：场站政策限制工程与运营数据离开电厂、本地算力有限，且错误的因果归因可能误导事故响应。我们报告了在两座燃气电厂部署控制逻辑证据层的经验，该证据层是更广泛的本地运维辅助系统的基础。两个原型系统揭示了生成式模型在哪些环节引入了可避免的不确定性与成本。第一个原型使用视觉语言模型（VLM）从工程师日常交换的PDF打印件中重建控制拓扑：在完整的6,979页文档上，连接提取精确率仅为0.51，且在4块H200 GPU上耗时3.1小时；随后与控制工程师的沟通发现，原创作系统本身即提供原生结构化导出功能。第二个原型使用LLM（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 在物理隔离的燃气电厂部署控制逻辑LLM助手时，用VLM从PDF重建控制拓扑代价高且精度低（仅0.51），而作者系统的原生结构化导出可避免这些问题，表明本地LLM系统应优先依赖权威数据源并采用受限检索。
en_tdlr: In air-gapped power plants, a VLM-based control-topology reconstruction from PDFs proved costly and imprecise (0.51 precision) while the authoring system's native structured export avoided this, highlighting source authority and bounded retrieval as key lessons for on-premises LLM assistants.
